name: boosty-platform-load-tests
description: Comprehensive load testing for Boosty Platform backend to validate performance improvements through query optimization and caching implementation

scripts.test:baseline: node -e "import('./run-load-tests.js').then(m => { const runner = new m.default(); runner.runScenario('baseline', (await import('./load-test.config.js')).baselineConfig); })"
scripts.test:moderate: node -e "import('./run-load-tests.js').then(m => { const runner = new m.default(); runner.runScenario('moderate', (await import('./load-test.config.js')).moderateConfig); })"
scripts.test:high: node -e "import('./run-load-tests.js').then(m => { const runner = new m.default(); runner.runScenario('high', (await import('./load-test.config.js')).highConfig); })"
scripts.test:stress: node -e "import('./run-load-tests.js').then(m => { const runner = new m.default(); runner.runScenario('stress', (await import('./load-test.config.js')).stressConfig); })"
scripts.test:caching: node -e "import('./run-load-tests.js').then(m => { const runner = new m.default(); runner.runScenario('withCaching', (await import('./load-test.config.js')).withCachingConfig); })"
scripts.test:nocaching: node -e "import('./run-load-tests.js').then(m => { const runner = new m.default(); runner.runScenario('withoutCaching', (await import('./load-test.config.js')).withoutCachingConfig); })"
scripts.test:comparison: node -e "import('./scenarios/dashboard-metrics.test.js').then(m => { const test = new m.default(); test.runComparisonTests(); })"
scripts.report: node -e "import('./run-load-tests.js').then(m => { const runner = new m.default(); runner.generateReports(); })"
scripts.clean: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { if (fs.existsSync('./reports')) fs.rmSync('./reports', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Reports directory cleaned'); })"
scripts.help:
echo 'Available scripts:
  npm test - Run all load tests
  npm run test:baseline - Run baseline load test
  npm run test:moderate - Run moderate load test
  npm run test:high - Run high load test
  npm run test:stress - Run stress test
  npm run test:caching - Test with caching enabled
  npm run test:nocaching - Test with caching disabled
  npm run test:dashboard - Test dashboard metrics endpoint
  npm run test:transactions - Test transaction analytics endpoint
  npm run test:users - Test user metrics endpoint
  npm run test:investors - Test investor metrics endpoint
  npm run test:notifications - Test notifications endpoint
  npm run test:comparison - Run comparison tests
  npm run report - Generate reports only
  npm run clean - Clean reports directory
  npm run help - Show this help message'

author: Boosty Platform Team
